_comment: Examples under datrix/examples/ that are DELIBERATELY not registered in any
test-projects.json test set, with a reviewed reason -- the example-registry
OTHER unregistered example as a defect. There is no legitimate reason for an
example to be permanently excluded from every test set (an example that
should never run anywhere should not exist under datrix/examples/ at all),
so this file starts and is expected to stay EMPTY -- it exists as the
typed escape hatch the house pattern requires, not because a real
expected_count is a pinned, reviewed value: change it only in the same
change that adds or removes an entry.
